name: Daisy Cubes Are Conditioning-Closed
statement: Every nonempty coordinate conditioning of a daisy-cube representation is again a daisy cube, after reorienting the retained section when necessary.
proof: For a down-set $D$ and coordinate $x$, the zero-section is a down-set. The one-section, after deleting $x$, is also a down-set because $B\subseteq A$ and $A\cup\{x\}\in D$ imply $B\cup\{x\}\in D$.
